A1.note: Done. Discovery matches the ADRP/ADD base, the scaled entry load and the bound (codegen.c:511 jump_table_shape, :617 compare_bound, :756 snx_codegen_jump_table) and adds the cases to the flow (codegen.c:851). x86-64 and arm64 jump through a table of the case labels (mach_codegen.inc:1506-1539 jtab_new; x64_codegen.c:96-98, :462; arm64_codegen.c:91-93, :360) when the function has more than 24 leaders; the RISC back ends define no MG_JTAB and reach the cases through the dispatch block. Tests: codegen_test.c:238-452, recompiler_library.c:144.

A2.note: Missing. The seeds are the symbols, relative relocations (loader.c:393-401: vtables and callbacks), the text start, hints, .eh_frame ranges and taken addresses (codegen.c:1440-1530). No RTTI or method-table pass and no gap sweep.

A3.note: Missing. Units are consecutive functions up to unit_instructions (module_a64.c:352-360), so a new function moves later boundaries; the x86-64 unit cache is in memory only (x64_cache.c). The ThinLTO and IR-merge paths of this item went with LLVM. This item is one the redesign (#3024) changes; its state here is today's only.

A5.note: Missing. ir_branch_profile went with LLVM (ini.c:511) and the native back ends read no profile; --layout is said and has no effect yet, the native back end ordering no functions (recompile.c:859, module_a64.c:321-323), while the linker orders .text.snx_hot.N sections (link_elf.c) and tools/layout.py makes an order.

L1.note: Retired in favor of the hook system, as before.

L2.note: Missing, and blocked by A5: there is no profile of BLR targets to read. This item is one the redesign (#3024) changes; its state here is today's only.

L3.note: Missing. A dynamic call still loads code_lo, code_hi and disp from CPU before the slot (x64_codegen.c:375-395 calldyn; module_x64.c:344-396 snx_import_dyn). This item is one the redesign (#3024) changes; its state here is today's only.

L4.note: Partial. An NRO the recompiler found in the RomFS is made ahead of time for a fixed slot, and CPU.disp covers [code_lo, hi) up to the slots (nro_slots.h:3-10; ldr.c:5-9, :130-150; guest_jit.c:617). An NRO mapped anywhere else, or found at run time only, is the JIT's, outside CPU.disp, and a call into it still goes through RtAPI.miss. This item is one the redesign (#3024) changes; its state here is today's only.

J2.note: Done. A miss thread at the guest thread's priority takes only the pcs a thread waits on; the compile threads go to nice 10, or below normal on Windows (jit_service.c:1360-1384 thread_priority, :1388-1400 worker). This item is one the redesign (#3024) changes; its state here is today's only.

J3.note: Missing. HOST_MACHINE is 0 on RISC-V, LoongArch, MIPS64 and s390x (code_loader.c:68-90). This item is one the redesign (#3024) changes; its state here is today's only.

J4.note: Missing. Every AOT unit is made with stale checks (module_a64.c:139), at the entry and after each call (mach_codegen.inc:197-209; x64_codegen.c:425-439). This item is one the redesign (#3024) changes; its state here is today's only.

I1.note: Missing. A crash names the recompiled function nearest below the host pc and the offset in it (crash.c:76-99), not the guest instruction; the native objects carry no line table.

I2.note: Missing in the native back ends. abi_contract went with LLVM (ini.c:506). Pinned registers are stored before every call and reloaded after it (mach_codegen.inc:1501-1504 after_call, :2175-2180).

I3.note: Missing. Guest registers stay in host registers inside a function (mach_codegen.inc:2173-2178 choose_pins), but a guest function is still void(CPU*, u64) (cpu.h:96) and every call passes them through CPU.

I4.note: Missing. GuestFn returns nothing (cpu.h:96); the caller compares CPU.pc in memory with pc+4 (x64_codegen.c:425-433 check_return).

I5.note: Not done: every backward branch still reads CPU.poll, laid out with one taken jump and the slow call out of line (x64_codegen.c:441-450; mach_codegen.inc:181-184, :1631-1659).

I6.note: Missing. Flags are reused inside a block's region only; the guest state is in CPU or its pins at every block's start and end (mach_codegen.inc:19-23).

I15.note: Done on x86-64 and arm64. x86-64: whole-vector FP with lane guards and one cold helper call per guest instruction, snx_x64_fp_vec (x64_vec.c:446-499, :685-721). arm64: the guest's own SIMD&FP words (arm64_vec.c:71-82). The RISC back ends have no vector values and make AdvSIMD from the Sail's scalar code (risc_codegen.inc:279-282). Tests: native_vfp_* (tests/CMakeLists.txt:1264-1298).

I8.note: Done. x86-64 computes FRECPE and FRSQRTE inline for every lane at once where all lanes are normal, the rest in one cold call (x64_vec.c:622-651, :1346-1354); arm64 runs the guest's own word. FRECPX is the Sail's code. Tests: native_recpe, native_recpx, native_rsqrte, native_estimates (tests/CMakeLists.txt:1270-1292).

I9.note: Done. x86-64 makes shifts by register as whole vectors (bytes and halves by products, words by AVX2), lane by lane in general-purpose code where no form exists, with QC (x64_vec.c:1029-1141, :1525). Test: native_simd_shift (tests/CMakeLists.txt:1284).

I11.note: Partial. Done: F16C for half conversions (x64_vec.c:789-801) and ROUNDSx for scalar FRINT (sailgen x64_a64.h:257-273). Missing: the residual proof of an FMA's inexact flag; the x86-64 fast paths still wait until FPSR.IXC is set (x64_a64.h:68-80). Test: native_fma_residual (tests/CMakeLists.txt:1296).

I12.note: Done. arm64 runs the guest's SIMD&FP words as its own under the guest's FPCR, the host FPSR ORed into the guest's after (arm64_vec.c:71-82, :150-170; sailgen arm64_a64.h:373-384). Test: tests/arm64_fpenv_code.c.

I13.note: Missing. Each LDXR and STXR is made alone with the monitor (sailgen mach_a64.h:817-845; mach_codegen.inc:1600); no loop becomes one atomic.

I14.note: Done through the hook system: memcpy, memmove and memset (pure, checkable against the game's code), memcmp and strlen have native handlers (hooks.hook:37-48; settings.txt:1648-1686).

M1.note: Partial. Done: store buffering, message passing (DMB, STLR/LDAR, split barrier), WRC and the spin load (gnuabi_litmus.py:50-81; tests/litmus/, five herd7 tests), and DMB ISHST as dmb ishst on arm64 (sailgen arm64_a64.h:371). Missing: load buffering, IRIW, message passing with an address dependency.

M2.note: Missing. The reservation is the largest tier the host gives (mem.c:1048-1084) with no guard past it, and there is no masking setting.

M3.note: Not done for recompiled code: it keeps the guest memory base in a register (mach_codegen.inc:85 mempin). The identity reservation exists for NCE only (mem.c:1087-1119).

S1.note: Missing. An SVC syncs the pins as a call does (mach_codegen.inc:2107, :2137, :2174).

R1.note: Partial. Asynchronous signals have frames, masks, sigaltstack, SA_RESTORER and rt_sigreturn (signals.c:1-8; test tests/gnuabi/signals.c through gnuabi_threads.py). A fault in guest code reaches gnu_signal_fault only from src/android/bridge/hle_signal.c:333, and needs I1 for its pc.

R2.note: Done as NCE on AArch64 Linux and Android: the game's code runs at its own addresses, patched words call the runtime, and a signal stops it for CPU.poll (nce.h:3-11; nce.c:246-262). Tests: nce_patch.c, nce_module.c, nce_host.c.
